ModuleName: 1 -GitHub, GitHub Pages, and Your First HTML Page

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline of the module's learning topics — covering GitHub fundamentals, repository creation, GitHub Pages deployment, and writing a first HTML document — used by instructors to organize content sequence and by learners to preview what concepts and skills the module will teach.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: This artifact is a structured overview of the module's learning topics — covering GitHub's purpose, account setup, GitHub Pages configuration, and creating a first HTML page — that learners and instructors can use as a navigational reference to see what subjects will be taught and in what order.

Artifacts.Name: Writing Your First HTML Document
Artifacts.Description: This text-based lesson introduces learners to the fundamental structure of an HTML document—including key elements like the doctype declaration, head, and body—guiding them step-by-step through writing their first complete HTML file and understanding how a browser renders it into a visible web page.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to GitHub
Artifacts.Description: An interactive reading introducing GitHub and its underlying technology, Git, explaining version control concepts and why GitHub is a widely used platform for storing, managing, and sharing code, intended for learners with no prior experience.

Artifacts.Name: Creating Your First Repository
Artifacts.Description: An interactive reading that walks learners through creating their first GitHub repository, explaining what a repository is, what each setup option means, and why creating a repo is the required first step for any project.

Artifacts.Name: Deploying with GitHub Pages
Artifacts.Description: An interactive reading on GitHub Pages that explains what the free static-site hosting service is, how it works, and how learners can use it to publish their HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files to the web without renting a server or using FTP.

Artifacts.Name: Writing Your First HTML Document
Artifacts.Description: This text-based lesson introduces learners to the structure and syntax of an HTML document—explaining how browsers interpret plain text HTML files—and guides them through building their first complete HTML page, serving as the primary reading material for the foundational web development topic in the module.
